notes: Counts for groups such as entrance buildings/greenhouses are not asserted as exhaustive individual counts. Separate source-specific placements are required for remote components;this document prevents castle-only approval from claiming whole-site completion.

parts.title: Castle,terraces and fortifications
parts.notes: Castle exterior core and approximate terraced gardens;fortification and landscape completeness still pending.

placementControls.title: Powder Tower
placementControls.notes: The four castle detail levels use mappedLocalCenter for the Powder Tower. The viewer replaces the exact native tower footprint while the castle model is loaded. The roof, wall details and foothill landscape remain approximations.

parts.title: Associated entrance buildings
parts.notes: The gatehouse and both courtyard wings have independently reviewed placements. The nearby former tax office at Piastów Śląskich 5 has a separate hotel model, identified by the National Heritage Institute entry and the labeled aerial. The hotel and entrance group render together.

parts.title: Park pavilion/mausoleum
parts.notes: The restored chapel exterior, signed footprint, curved entrance stair and modeled clearing grade passed review in the viewer. The crypt and interior remain outside the model.

parts.title: Three park gates
parts.notes: Lion Gate, Jeździecka Gate and Hochberg Alley Gate have signed path alignment and ground-contact reviews at all four detail levels. Each gate preserves its open route and neighboring mapped features.

parts.title: Two Swiss houses
parts.notes: Both independently mapped house exteriors have reviewed dormer and porch facing, physical landings, four detail levels and geographic placement. Both render with Lion Gate and restore their own footprint if the landmark fails to load.

parts.title: Old Książ romantic ruin
parts.notes: The four wall traces, retained hillside, fitted portal approaches and trail breach passed independent review. The roofless exterior remains open in all four detail levels.

parts.title: Five stables
parts.notes: The structure fits the two mapped building outlines. The entrance arch follows the road into the court. It supplies the stone lining while the viewer draws the road at terrain grade. The inferred tunnel returns if the model fails to load.

parts.title: Covered riding hall
parts.notes: The separately mapped riding hall and annexes sit on their fitted plinth within the stable ensemble asset.

parts.title: Carriage house
parts.notes: The structure fits the two mapped building outlines. The entrance arch follows the road into the court. It supplies the stone lining while the viewer draws the road at terrain grade. The inferred tunnel returns if the model fails to load.

parts.title: Forge
parts.notes: The two photographed portals face the inner yard of the mapped L-shaped footprint, with thresholds 54 cm apart on the slope. The pavement joins the original terrain within 8 mm at the sampled points across all four levels. The exterior and four levels were reviewed as an independent building.

parts.title: Forester house
parts.notes: The porch faces the Jeździecka approach and the timber gable faces the mapped footpath. The original terrain supplies the datum. The pavement joins the original terrain within 8 mm at the sampled points across all four levels. The exterior and four levels were reviewed as an independent building.

parts.title: Lubiechów Palm House
parts.notes: The modeled plinth sits on the sampled slope. The landing meets the rendered footway within 11 mm at the sampled points in all four detail levels. The occupied masks retain both open courts and replace the two mapped records for the building and its attached bay.

parts.title: Greenhouse group
parts.notes: The connected Palm House ranges keep their two courtyards. The separate west glasshouses occupy their own mapped footprint, with both western slots open. The present-day roof and entrance details of the separate ranges are interpreted.

parts.title: Palm House boiler building
parts.notes: The placement occupies its own mapped footprint. The foundation follows the terrain and the landing meets the sampled approach within 13 mm in all four detail levels. Façade details and dimensions are interpretations of the historic exterior, with current restoration and interiors outside the review.
